notes.title: Sound Effects and Explosions Reworked
notes.content:
We have reworked all of the sound effects and improved all of the explosions in the game.  This should give a quality boost to the gameplay experience. Enemy ships have also been added to level 2, making that level feel more engaging. 


* Sound effects for jet fighters and spaceships added
* Ship destroying sound effect and explosions added
* Explosions and sound effects added for buildings
* Better sound effects for laser weapons and cannons
* Missile sound effects Improved
* Anti aircraft sound effects Improved
* Proximity missile lock on radius lowered
* Health regeneration goes 0.2 seconds faster
* Level 4 - Difficulty lowered and tweaked
* Level 4 - More sound effects added to bombers 
* Level 2 - Enemy ships added
* Level 2 - More ally fighters added
* Various more sound effects tweaks

Let us know what you think. The game continues to be updated and improved.  Thanks for playing the game!
